heading.title: Of Penalties in Case of Dishonour of Certain Cheques for Insufficiency of Funds in the Accounts3

article.title: Bank’s slip prima facie evidence of certain facts.
article.content:
146Bank’s slip prima facie evidence of certain facts.

Section 146  ·  Chapter XVII  ·  page 31 of the Act
The Court shall, in respect of every proceeding under this Chapter, on production of Bank's slip or memo having thereon the official mark denoting that the cheque has been dishonoured, presume the fact of dishonour of such cheque, unless and until such fact is disproved.
